digest.headline: The Nasdaq reached a record high as technology shares rallied, while Saudi Aramco halted crude supplies to Europe following a pipeline attack.

lede.b: The Nasdaq stock index, which tracks a large group of technology companies, reached a record high because investors felt optimistic about artificial intelligence, which is computer technology that mimics human thinking. This tech surge pushed the wider S&P 500 stock market up by 1.5%. Meanwhile, government bond yields, which are the returns paid to people who lend money to the state, went down during the trading day. One Federal Reserve official, who helps run the central bank that manages United States money, even suggested raising interest rates because inflation, which means rising prices for everyday goods, stayed stubborn. The Nasdaq achieved this record close on the back of this tech strength.
lede.i: The Nasdaq achieved a record-high close driven by renewed optimism in artificial intelligence. This technology strength lifted the broader market, pushing the S&P 500 up by 1.5%. Meanwhile, inflation persistence prompted a Federal Reserve official to support an interest rate hike. Treasury yields retreated during the trading session.
lede.a: The Nasdaq achieved a record-high close driven by renewed artificial intelligence optimism, lifting the S&P 500 by 1.5%. Concurrently, inflation persistence prompted a Federal Reserve official to support an interest rate hike, while Treasury yields retreated during the trading session.

items.b: The Nasdaq stock index reached a record high due to tech optimism, while Iambic Therapeutics filed for an initial public offering.
items.i: The Nasdaq reached a record high as tech shares surged, while biotech firm Iambic Therapeutics filed for a US initial public offering.
items.a: The Nasdaq printed a record high on tech strength while Iambic Therapeutics filed for a US initial public offering backed by Nvidia.

items.b: The FTSE 100 index in London rose 0.75 percent to finish at 10,739.01 points.
items.i: The FTSE 100 index finished the session up 0.75% at 10,739.01 as miners and banks outweighed oil.
items.a: The FTSE 100 closed up 0.75% at 10,739.01 as strength in miners and banks eclipsed oil stock weakness.

items.b: The DAX index in Germany climbed 1.07 percent while the central bank noted that healthcare reforms will push up future prices.
items.i: The DAX closed 1.07% higher as equities rallied, while the Bundesbank reported that inflation will remain elevated.
items.a: The DAX advanced 1.07% near a resistance cluster at 25,832 as the Bundesbank noted healthcare reform will add 0.5 percentage points to inflation in 2027.

items.b: The Japanese yen dropped past 157 per dollar and the Nikkei 225 held steady at 65,018.95 during a holiday.
items.i: The US dollar-yen exchange rate pushed below 157 following a central bank rate check while the Nikkei 225 held at 65,018.95.
items.a: The dollar-yen rate slipped below 157 on intervention risks while the Nikkei 225 held at 65,018.95 during a holiday closure.

thread.b: Stock markets and central banks moved across several countries today. Energy supplies faced disruptions in the Middle East.
thread.i: Equity markets pushed higher in major Western and Asian centers. Central banks managed currency levels and monitored price pressures.

United States of America.label: United States
United States of America.sub: Nasdaq sets record as tech stocks rally

stories.t: Nasdaq Sets Record High as Technology Shares Surge
stories.b: The Nasdaq stock market lists many technology companies. It hit a brand new record high close. A stock market is a place where pieces of businesses are bought and sold. Technology shares jumped because people felt more optimistic about artificial intelligence. The S&P 500 index also grew by 1.5%.
stories.i: The Nasdaq achieved a record-high close driven by renewed optimism in artificial intelligence. Tech strength lifted the broader market, pushing the S&P 500 up by 1.5%. Meanwhile, inflation persistence prompted a Federal Reserve official to support an interest rate hike. Treasury yields retreated during the trading session.
stories.a: The Nasdaq notched a record-high close as artificial intelligence sentiment reignited risk appetite across tech equities. Concurrently, S&P 500 gains occurred despite new market lows outnumbering highs. Treasury yields fell back, and a Federal Reserve official cited persistent price pressures to justify an earlier rate increase stance.

stories.t: Iambic Therapeutics Files for US Initial Public Offering
stories.b: Iambic Therapeutics filed papers for an initial public offering in the United States. An initial public offering happens when a private company sells shares to the public for the first time. The company is backed by Nvidia and the Qatar Investment Authority. This filing takes place while the biotech industry experiences a boom.
stories.i: Iambic Therapeutics filed for a United States initial public offering. The biotech firm is backed by Nvidia and the Qatar Investment Authority. This filing expands the ongoing biotech issuance wave.
stories.a: Iambic Therapeutics submitted its initial public offering paperwork in the United States. The enterprise, backed by Nvidia and the Qatar Investment Authority, taps into the active biotech primary market segment.

politics.i: A Federal Reserve official addressed price stability challenges.
politics.a: A Federal Reserve policymaker spoke on persistence factors governing monetary policy.

timeline: Nasdaq reaches a record high close driven by technology shares

United Kingdom.label: United Kingdom
United Kingdom.sub: London market closes up as miners and banks outweigh oil

stories.t: London Index Rises
stories.b: The FTSE 100 is a big list that tracks the shares of the one hundred biggest companies traded in London. Shares are tiny slices of ownership in a company. This index closed at 10,739.01. That is an increase of 0.75%.
stories.i: The FTSE 100 index finished the session at 10,739.01. This marked a gain of 0.75%.
stories.a: The FTSE 100 closed at 10,739.01, registering a 0.75% advance. The move reflects sector-specific outperformance.

stories.t: Sector Performance Diverges in London
stories.b: Miners dig up metals and banks lend money. Both groups of companies did very well today. Their strong results helped push the market up. They made up for weakness in oil companies, which did not do as well.
stories.i: Miners and banks drove the positive session in London. Strength in these two sectors outweighed weakness in oil stocks.
stories.a: Equity gains were propelled by miners and banks. Their upward momentum offset negative pressure from the oil sub-sector.

Germany.label: Germany
Germany.sub: German equities rise as price pressures stay elevated

stories.t: German Equities Advance
stories.b: The main stock market index in Germany is called the DAX. Shares represent small pieces of ownership in companies. The DAX index went up by 1.07% at the close of trade. European stocks climbed due to strength in technology and banks while oil prices fell.
stories.i: The DAX closed 1.07% higher in the latest trading session. European equities rallied as strength in technology and banking shares offset declining oil prices. Traders pushed the benchmark index near a resistance cluster at 25,832.
stories.a: The DAX advanced 1.07% to close the session following a broader European equity rally led by technology and banking sectors alongside retreating crude values. Price action stalled near a triple resistance cluster defined around the 25,832 level.

stories.t: Bundesbank Reports on Price Pressures
stories.b: Inflation means that prices for everyday goods go up over time. The central bank of Germany is the Bundesbank. It stated that inflation will stay elevated for now. A planned healthcare reform will add 0.5 percentage point to price growth in early 2027.
stories.i: German inflation will remain elevated according to the Bundesbank monthly report. Policymakers noted that an upcoming healthcare reform will contribute an additional 0.5 percentage point to the headline metric in early 2027.
stories.a: The Bundesbank monthly report indicated that domestic inflation will persist at elevated levels in the near term. The central bank specified that an upcoming healthcare reform will introduce a 0.5 percentage point impulse to the index in early 2027.

politics.b: Germany is a major European economy where financial markets track corporate performance and central bank data closely.
politics.i: German economic policy and central bank reporting guide market expectations across the Eurozone.
politics.a: Bundesbank structural forecasts and pan-European equity flows dictate short-term positioning in German asset classes.

timeline: The DAX closed 1.07% higher after European stocks rallied on tech and banking strength.
The Bundesbank issued its monthly report predicting elevated price pressures and healthcare reform impacts.

Japan.label: Japan
Japan.sub: Yen weakens past 157 and Nikkei closes at 65,018.95

stories.t: Yen Slips Below 157 as Traders Watch for Official Intervention
stories.b: The Japanese currency weakened past the 157 level against the US dollar. Currency traders call this price point USD/JPY. Officials in Tokyo watched the currency pace closely because rapid drops can hurt the domestic economy. The risk of government intervention rose as the currency eased. Currency markets monitor these movements constantly.
stories.i: The US dollar-yen exchange rate pushed below 157 following a Bank of Japan rate check. Authorities in Tokyo monitored the pace of the decline while the risk of direct market intervention climbed. The weaker currency followed a reduction in speculative yen longs after a squeeze in the previous week. Foreign exchange traders priced in heightened volatility as the currency eased further.
stories.a: The USD/JPY pair breached the 157 threshold following a Bank of Japan rate check that triggered speculative unwinding. Leveraged accounts shed yen longs after heavy squeezes recorded in the IMM Commitment of Traders reports. Authorities in Tokyo maintained heightened alert levels for direct currency intervention as spot prices drifted lower. Implied volatility rose across near-term options as participants recalibrated risk premiums following recent monetary policy adjustments.

stories.t: Nikkei 225 Holds at 65,018.95 During Holiday Closure
stories.b: The main Japanese stock market index finished at 65,018.95. This index is called the Nikkei 225. Tokyo financial markets closed for Respect for the Aged Day. The market held these levels following a rally driven by the central bank. Exchange-traded funds tracking the yen faced headwinds despite previous interest rate hikes.
stories.i: The Nikkei 225 index settled at 65,018.95 following a prior Bank of Japan-fuelled rally. Tokyo equities remained stationary as markets closed for Respect for the Aged Day. Yen exchange-traded funds encountered ongoing headwinds despite previous rate hikes by the central bank. Mixed market forces left rating agencies issuing hold recommendations on currency-linked funds.
stories.a: The Nikkei 225 index maintained its position at 65,018.95 following an expansionary phase driven by central bank policy shifts. Domestic equity trading halted as Tokyo observed Respect for the Aged Day. Yen-denominated exchange-traded funds continued to face structural headwinds despite prior monetary tightening cycles. Market participants weighed opposing macroeconomic vectors, resulting in neutral hold classifications across derivative products.

politics.b: Local leaders in northern Japan welcomed foreign students to support their aging community. Tokyo also planned an artificial intelligence robot contest for the International Space Station. Japanese diplomats engaged with the Taliban to explore paths for change in Afghanistan.
politics.i: Communities in northern Japan integrated foreign students to counter demographic aging. Government planners announced an artificial intelligence robot contest scheduled for the International Space Station. Foreign policy officials pursued engagement with the Taliban to encourage administrative shifts in Afghanistan.
politics.a: Northern municipalities absorbed foreign student cohorts to mitigate severe demographic contraction. Aerospace agencies scheduled an artificial intelligence robotics competition aboard the International Space Station. Diplomatic channels opened official engagement with Taliban representatives to evaluate governance trajectories in Afghanistan.

timeline: Tokyo markets closed for Respect for the Aged Day with the Nikkei 225 at 65,018.95
The USD/JPY exchange rate slipped below 157 following a Bank of Japan rate check

China.label: China
China.sub: Shengu plunge, electronics goals, and flagship phone pricing

stories.t: Shengu Group Shares Drop After Exchange Intervention
stories.b: Shengu Group shares fell nearly 35% after the Shanghai Stock Exchange stepped in. This drop happened following six trading halts over three days. Trading halts are temporary pauses in buying and selling put in place by exchanges to calm wild price swings. The stock price fell heavily once trading resumed.
stories.i: Shengu Group shares plunged nearly 35% after the Shanghai Stock Exchange intervened following six trading halts in three days. Regulatory intervention halted the extreme volatility that had repeatedly paused the stock. The sharp downward re-pricing followed the resumption of trading after the administrative pause.
stories.a: Shengu Group equity plummeted nearly 35% following intervention by the Shanghai Stock Exchange after six trading halts in three days. The exchange's direct action curtailed the pathological trading loops that triggered repeated suspensions. Market participants aggressively marked down the valuation once liquidity was forcibly restored.

stories.t: China Sets 30 Trillion Yuan Revenue Target for Electronics
stories.b: China set a goal to reach 30 trillion yuan in electronics manufacturing revenue by 2030. Revenue is the total amount of money a company brings in from selling goods before any costs are taken away. This target guides the country's technology and manufacturing sectors over the coming years.
stories.i: China targeted 30 trillion yuan in electronics manufacturing revenue by 2030. The ambitious top-line goal outlines industrial expansion parameters for domestic producers. Policymakers intend for this sector scale to anchor broader economic output.
stories.a: China targeted 30 trillion yuan in electronics manufacturing revenue by 2030. The industrial objective establishes a massive structural benchmark for supply chain output. Long-term capital expenditure allocations across the sector are now anchored to this governmental trajectory.

stories.t: Vivo X500 Launch Price Climbs Early in China
stories.b: Vivo priced its X500 series launch 1,100 yuan higher than previous models. This increase marks an early arrival for flagship smartphone price hikes across the country. Flagship phones are the top-tier, most expensive devices that companies sell.
stories.i: Vivo priced its X500 series launch 1,100 yuan higher as flagship smartphone price hikes arrived early in China. Manufacturers are pushing average selling prices upward despite competitive pressures. Consumer electronics producers are testing market tolerance for cost increases.
stories.a: Vivo priced its X500 series launch 1,100 yuan higher, signalling early arrivals for flagship smartphone price hikes across China. Margin compression across component supply chains is forcing OEMs to pass cost pressures directly to end-users. The pricing shift challenges historical deflationary trends in consumer hardware.

politics.b: The People’s Bank of China worked with the Monetary Authority of Singapore on green finance. Taiwan sent its labor minister to an APEC meeting hosted in China.
politics.i: The People’s Bank of China and the Monetary Authority of Singapore strengthened cooperation in transition and adaptation finance at the 4th Singapore-China Green Finance Taskforce Meeting. Taiwan sent its labor minister to attend an APEC meeting in China.
politics.a: The People’s Bank of China advanced cooperation with the Monetary Authority of Singapore on transition and adaptation finance during the 4th Singapore-China Green Finance Taskforce Meeting. Taiwan dispatched its labor minister to participate in an APEC meeting held in China.

timeline: Shengu Group shares plunged nearly 35% after exchange intervention following six trading halts.
Vivo launched its X500 series with a launch price jump of 1,100 yuan.
The People’s Bank of Singapore and China met for the 4th Singapore-China Green Finance Taskforce.

India.label: India
India.sub: Sensex gains, oil drops, and RBI plans repo auction

stories.t: Stock Indices Climb as Oil Prices Drop
stories.src: BBN Times · INDIA New England News · AD HOC NEWS
stories.b: The BSE SENSEX index went up by 564 points to reach 74,858.99. Another index named Nifty closed above 23,400. This happened because oil prices went down. Bharti Airtel stock ended the day lower at the close.
stories.i: The BSE SENSEX rose 564 points to 74,858.99 as falling oil prices relieved markets after six weekly losses. The Nifty closed above 23,400 despite a drag that pushed Bharti Airtel stock lower at the close.
stories.a: The BSE SENSEX advanced 564 points to close at 74,858.99 alongside Nifty breaching the 23,400 threshold following a retreat in crude prices. Broad index momentum persisted despite localized drag from equities such as Bharti Airtel at the close.

stories.t: Central Bank Schedules Variable Rate Reverse Repo Auction
stories.b: The Reserve Bank of India decided to run an overnight variable rate reverse repo auction on September 22, 2026. This auction has a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore. Banks will use a one-day window starting at 9:30 AM.
stories.i: The Reserve Bank of India announced an overnight variable rate reverse repo auction for September 22, 2026. The liquidity operation targets a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore with a one-day tenor. Authorised institutions will access the window between 09:30 AM and 10:00 AM.
stories.a: The Reserve Bank of India scheduled an overnight variable rate reverse repo auction under the liquidity adjustment facility for September 22, 2026. The operation targets absorption of a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore across a single-day tenor. Counterparties will bid within the 09:30 AM to 10:00 AM window ahead of the reversal on September 23, 2026.

stories.t: Government Announces Dated Security Sale and Floating Rate Bond Coupon
stories.b: The Government of India planned a sale of one dated security for ₹34,000 crore maturing on May 11, 2036. The interest rate on the Government of India Floating Rate Bond 2033 was set at 6.87 percent per annum for the period from September 22, 2026, to March 21, 2027.
stories.i: The Government of India scheduled a re-issue of the 6.94% GS 2036 security to raise ₹34,000 crore at auction. Concurrently, the central bank fixed the coupon rate for the Government of India Floating Rate Bond 2033 at 6.87 percent per annum for the half year ending March 21, 2027.
stories.a: The administration announced a re-issue of the 6.94% GS 2036 paper for a notified amount of ₹34,000 crore with settlement scheduled for September 28, 2026. Simultaneously, the coupon for the Government of India Floating Rate Bond 2033 was fixed at 6.87 percent per annum based on the weighted average yield of preceding 182-day treasury bill auctions.

politics.b: Saudi Aramco halted crude supply to India following a pipeline attack, prompting the company to boost crude loadings after the disruption.
politics.i: Saudi Aramco halted crude supply to India after a pipeline attack, subsequently increasing crude loadings to manage the infrastructure disruption.
politics.a: Saudi Aramco suspended crude deliveries to India following a pipeline attack, prompting subsequent adjustments to boost crude loadings to offset the supply disruption.

timeline: RBI introduced a special USD-INR forex swap facility.
The swap scheme closed for FCNR(B) deposits.

Brazil.label: Brazil
Brazil.sub: Petrobras subsidy costs, drilling disputes and rate cuts

stories.t: Petrobras Backs Diesel Subsidies as Payments Reach $1.9bn
stories.b: Petrobras is the giant Brazilian oil company controlled by the state. Its board just backed a new diesel subsidy program. This is a system where the government helps pay for fuel to keep prices low. Fuel payments hit $1.9bn.
stories.i: Petrobras backed a new diesel subsidy program after fuel payments hit $1.9bn. The state-controlled energy producer faces cumulative diesel subsidies coming back into play. The board approved the arrangement despite ongoing financial exposure.
stories.a: Petrobras institutionalised its exposure to domestic fuel price smoothing via a new diesel subsidy program as cumulative outlays reached $1.9bn. The reactivation of structural fuel subsidies shifts margin risk back to the balance sheet. Investors must now reprice the discount applied to state-directed pricing mechanisms.

stories.t: Federal Ministry Seeks Drilling Suspension at Amazon River Mouth
stories.src: CUG Click Oil and Gas · marketscreener.com
stories.b: The Amazon River mouth is a very sensitive ecological area. Brazil’s Federal Public Ministry wants to stop a drilling license there. They demand community consultation before any work continues.
stories.i: Brazil’s Federal Public Ministry moved to suspend a drilling license at the Amazon River mouth. Prosecutors demanded formal community consultation for the project. Petrobras previously reported that the same discovery yielded very high-quality oil.
stories.a: Brazil’s Federal Public Ministry initiated legal action to suspend Petrobras' drilling license at the Amazon River mouth. The injunction demand hinges on mandatory community consultation protocols. This judicial friction threatens development timelines for assets previously touted for high-quality hydrocarbon yields.

stories.t: Economists Lower 2026 Selic Forecast Following Rate Cut
stories.b: The Selic is the main interest rate set by Brazil's central bank. Local economists lowered their forecast for where this rate will sit in 2026. This change happened right after a rate cut.
stories.i: Brazil economists lowered their 2026 Selic forecast. The adjustment followed a recent interest rate cut by policymakers. The revised outlook reflects shifting expectations for monetary easing paths.
stories.a: Analyst consensus for the terminal Selic trajectory shifted downward following the latest monetary easing cycle. Economists recalibrated 2026 rate projections to mirror a faster pace of policy normalization. This adjustment implies a lower neutral rate assumption embedded in local yield curves.

politics.b: The Brazilian government controls Petrobras and manages fuel subsidies while state ministries push environmental restrictions.
politics.i: State involvement in Petrobras remains pronounced through mandated diesel subsidies and majority ownership, balanced against judicial oversight from federal ministries.
politics.a: State intervention via mandatory fuel subsidy programs highlights the ongoing structural subordination of corporate cash flows to federal policy goals, running parallel to intensifying environmental litigation.

timeline: Petrobras board backs new diesel subsidy program as payments hit $1.9bn.
Brazil’s Federal Public Ministry seeks to suspend Petrobras drilling license at Amazon River mouth.
Brazil economists lower 2026 Selic forecast following a rate cut.

Saudi Arabia.label: Saudi Arabia
Saudi Arabia.sub: Aramco shifts exports after pipeline attack

stories.t: Pipeline Attack Disrupts Aramco Exports
stories.b: Saudi Aramco is the massive state-owned oil company of Saudi Arabia. Following a pipeline attack, the firm halted its crude supplies to India and October shipments to Europe. It also sought diesel in the Mediterranean. Eastern Pipes stated that its new contract with Aramco is unrelated to these emergency repairs.
stories.i: Saudi Aramco halted October crude supplies to Europe and shipments to India following a pipeline attack. The disruption forced the firm to seek diesel in the Mediterranean. Eastern Pipes clarified that its new contract with Aramco is not linked to the emergency repairs.
stories.a: Physical flow adjustments followed facility and pipeline strikes, halting October crude deliveries to European and Indian off-takers while triggering spot Mediterranean diesel inquiries. Eastern Pipes confirmed its fresh Aramco contract operates independently of emergency restoration work.

stories.t: Aramco Ramps Up Gulf Shipments
stories.b: Saudi Aramco loaded 14 million barrels of crude in a single day. The company used 7 very large crude carriers to expand its exports. These shipments moved out through the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.i: Saudi Aramco expanded Gulf oil exports by loading 14 million barrels of crude in a day. The company deployed 7 very large crude carriers for this operation. All these expanded exports moved through the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.a: Daily liftings surged to 14 million barrels, utilizing 7 very large crude carriers to reroute volume. This export surge bypassed damaged inland infrastructure by routing entirely through the Strait of Hormuz.

politics.b: OPEC further lowered its growth forecast for global oil demand in the year 2026. Riyadh and Moscow remained silent on policy. Meanwhile, Saudi oil scientists worked on international climate reports.
politics.i: OPEC further reduced its 2026 global oil demand growth forecast. Silence persisted from Riyadh and Moscow regarding production policy. Separately, Saudi oil scientists contributed to major climate reports.
politics.a: OPEC downgraded its 2026 global oil demand growth projections amid ongoing communication silence from Riyadh and Moscow. Concurrently, domestic petroleum scientists participated in authoring key global climate assessments.

timeline: Saudi Aramco halts India and European October crude supplies after a pipeline attack.

Nigeria.label: Nigeria
Nigeria.sub: Naira movements and policy coordination agreements

stories.t: Naira Trades at NAFEM Following Dollar Liquidity Shifts
stories.src: Blueprint Newspapers · Business News Nigeria · Arbiterz
stories.b: The naira is the official money used in Nigeria. The exchange rate tells you how many naira it takes to buy one United States dollar. The currency closed at N1,329.99 per dollar at the NAFEM window. Foreign portfolio investors dominated the dollar supply in the market.
stories.i: The naira recorded a closing rate of N1,329.99 per dollar at the NAFEM exchange window. Foreign portfolio investors drove dollar liquidity across the market. Domestic inflation and fuel costs continued to exert pressure on the currency.
stories.a: The naira settled at N1,329.99/$ at NAFEM as foreign portfolio investment flows dictated spot liquidity. Strong greenback valuations and domestic energy expenses generated persistent depreciation pressures. Marginal shifts in foreign investor participation altered daily order book dynamics.

stories.t: Ministry of Finance and Central Bank Sign Coordination Memorandum
stories.b: The Federal Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of Nigeria signed a memorandum of understanding. This agreement focuses on better policy coordination between the two institutions. Both government bodies want to align their financial strategies.
stories.i: The Federal Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of Nigeria formalised an understanding on policy coordination. The memorandum establishes a framework for aligning fiscal and monetary measures. Both authorities aim to harmonise economic management through this pact.
stories.a: The Federal Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of Nigeria executed a memorandum of understanding on policy coordination. The institutional framework targets friction reduction between fiscal outlays and monetary tightening. Implementation efficacy depends on adherence to the joint guidelines outlined in the pact.

politics.b: A Nigerian court postponed a legal case involving El-Rufai. The lawsuit involves a claim of 1 billion naira. The court proceedings will happen at a later date.
politics.i: A Nigerian court adjourned the 1 billion naira lawsuit involving El-Rufai. Legal arguments and filings will resume on the rescheduled date. The postponement affects the immediate progression of the litigation.
politics.a: A Nigerian court issued an adjournment in the 1 billion naira litigation involving El-Rufai. The delay defers the adjudication of claims and preliminary objections. Counsel must await the newly appointed docket schedule for further submissions.

timeline: Federal Ministry of Finance and Central Bank of Nigeria sign policy MoU
Nigerian court postpones El-Rufai 1 billion naira lawsuit

stories.b: EVT looks at an A$800 million sale of assets. This review makes people think about fair value again. EVT trades on the ASX.
stories.i: EVT evaluates an A$800 million asset sales program. The review refocuses attention on the underlying fair value of the firm.
stories.a: EVT reviews an A$800 million asset divestment program, redirecting market focus toward intrinsic valuation metrics.

stories.t: ASX Appoints New Executive Team Members
stories.b: The ASX names Keir Barnes as its new chief financial officer. The company also adds Mark Peterson and Elaine Vaisanen to its executive leadership team.
stories.i: The ASX appoints Keir Barnes as CFO. Mark Peterson and Elaine Vaisanen join the executive leadership team alongside him.
stories.a: The ASX names Keir Barnes CFO while expanding its executive leadership team with the additions of Mark Peterson and Elaine Vaisanen.
